items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: I met him, first time was when I, we were doing one of the Broadway shows... I remember it was during an intermission and a rehearsal... I just followed him... after I got to know Faz better

ctx.x: How was it working with the Zell now?

Oh, it was fine. Uh, actually, I met him, first time was when I, we were doing one of the Broadway shows. I came down at the Civic. And, uh, I remember it was during an intermission and a rehearsal. Uh, he very casually turned around to me and says, come on, let's go have a beer. So, I just followed him. There was a little joint in the alley there that sold beer and oysters and everything. And, uh, I'm sitting there drinking a beer, and sure enough, it was Faz already on his second, he'd already gone on his…
Yeah, it does. So, and they have, usually have a wider lay in the reed, you know, so that the more wind, maybe that makes you thirsty. Maybe that's why, you know, why so many of them end up lushes.
